findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure SSL/TLS configuration
 * @description Disabling SSL certificate verification can allow man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-ssl-config
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // urllib with unverified context
    call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall() or
    // requests with verify=False
    exists(DataFlow::Node verify |
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request"]).getACall() and
      verify = call.getArgByName("verify") and
      verify.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = false
    ) or
    // urllib.request.urlopen with context parameter set to unverified
    exists(DataFlow::Node context |
      call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() and
      context = call.getArgByName("context")
    )
  )
select call, "Insecure SSL/TLS configuration that disables certificate verification."
findings.hypothesis: Check for disabled SSL certificate verification which could allow MITM attacks

message.text: Insecure SSL/TLS configuration that disables certificate verification.
Insecure SSL/TLS configuration that disables certificate verification.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Symlink race condition
 * @description Creating symlinks without proper checks can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/symlink-race
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-362
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["symlink", "link"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getMember("symlink_to").getACall()
  )
select call, "Symlink creation that may be vulnerable to race conditions if target path is not validated."
findings.hypothesis: Symlink operations without proper validation could lead to race conditions

message.text: Symlink creation that may be vulnerable to race conditions if target path is not validated.
